correctness.rationale: The calculation is correct. From the normal bundle sequence, c_1=(5-a-b)H and c_2=(10-5(a+b)+a^2+ab+b^2)H^2, so p_1=(5-a^2-b^2)H^2 and integrating H^2=ab gives sigma=ab(5-a^2-b^2)/3. At fixed S and gap g=b-a, minus three times the signature equals (S^4-10S^2+10g^2-g^4)/8. On even allowed gaps, g=2 uniquely maximizes the variable term; on odd gaps, g=1 and g=3 tie and every g at least five is lower. A fresh exact check for every S from 6 through 40 reproduced both formulas and all equality cases; the symbolic quartic argument proves all S.

originality.rationale: Originality fails under the implication standard. The exact tangent-bundle formula for complete intersections is classical and gives the pointwise signature formula for every bidegree by the standard Chern-to-Pontryagin calculation and Hirzebruch signature theorem. Once that stronger all-bidegree formula is known, imposing a+b=S and writing g=b-a reduces the claimed extremum to maximizing the elementary quartic 10g^2-g^4 on the allowed parity lattice. The gap-two even optimum and gap-one/gap-three odd tie are therefore routine corollaries of already-known complete-intersection characteristic-class data, even though no source with those extremal words was found.
